response.overview: It was high time that culture arrived on the southern banks of the Yarra, and if you want to perform Swan Lake in a fashion that will please even the most discerning of classical music aficionados, you better do it authentically – in the water. Starring Simon D’Orsogna, Brendan Kennedy, Michael Fink, Madeleine Fogarty, Philippa McMahon, Anthony Capsalis, Mark Gazman, Kate Dixon and Ann Burge.
response.title: NGV Water Music
